defs.def: a very large animal that lives in the sea and looks like a very large fish. There are several types of whale, some of which are hunted. 鲸

ex.s: “I remember the first time I saw a humpback whale; it just rose out of the water like some prehistoric creature and I thought it was smiling at us.
ex.t: "我记得第一次看到座头鲸；它就像某种史前生物一样从水中升起，我觉得它在对我们微笑。

ex.s: Go on a boat trip to see whales that jump out of the water and hear the song of dolphins that sing.
ex.t: 乘船出游，去看跃出水面的大鲸，听海豚歌唱。

ex.s: Mum was using Dad's phone to take photos of the colourful little houses along the coast when we saw something amazing - a killer whale!
ex.t: 妈妈正用爸爸的手机拍摄海岸边五颜六色的小房子，这时我们看到令人惊叹的一幕——一头虎鲸！

ex.s: Anyway, another family from Quebec was also on the boat and they got some great photos of the whale.
ex.t: 总之，另一家来自魁北克的人也在船上，他们拍到了一些很棒的鲸鱼照片。

ex.s: She can be seen worn/wearing mermaid clothing and dived/diving up to 50 feet underwater to swim with dolphins, sharks and whales.
ex.t: 可以看到她穿着美人鱼服装，下潜至水下50英尺，与海豚、鲨鱼和鲸鱼同游。

ex.s: While attacking from the ship, Aronnax and Conseil, along with the whale hunter Ned Land, fall into the sea, and discover that the “creature” is actually a submarine.
ex.t: 当他们从船上发起攻击时，阿龙纳斯和康塞尔连同捕鲸人尼德·兰一起坠入海中，发现那个“生物”其实是一艘潜艇。
